methodology.primary_measurement: In-process recall with result caching disabled; OS and SQLite caches are not flushed.
methodology.first_query: First query per configuration in the same Python process, not a cold-process or cold-OS-cache measurement.
methodology.cache_measurement: Each timed cached query immediately follows the identical warm-up query; this is a best-case hot-cache diagnostic.
methodology.quality: Evidence counts only when its original project, session, turn and source offset span match a returned hit and its text survives into the actual budgeted context.
methodology.scope: All methods receive the identical project scope, source transcripts, task metadata, query, result limit, and character budget.
methodology.units: Characters and UTF-8 bytes are exact; estimated_tokens is an engine heuristic, not tokenizer-measured cost.
methodology.unanswerable: Nonempty retrieval on an unanswerable question is measured; the benchmark does not generate answers or measure hallucinations.
limitations: Synthetic source and question templates; no real user conversations or external project engines are benchmarked.
Task identifiers are supplied metadata, not inferred clustering accuracy.
Directory strategy and page segmentation are separate factors; superiority is not assumed.
Split labels are caller-selected. Any split used to tune parameters must be treated as development evidence.
No LLM, network, embedding, agent orchestration, cold-process startup, or end-to-end answer latency is measured.
Source interval overlap is not semantic redundancy; paraphrase evaluation is limited to the included templates.
